title: Programming biological behavior with AI-guided de novo protein design.
one_liner_zh: 该文是一篇关于AI引导的从头蛋白质设计以编程生物行为的展望性综述，聚焦蛋白质结构设计方法及其向反应网络和细胞行为工程的拓展，虽缺乏具体方法创新，但紧密围绕蛋白质结构计算设计主题。
abstract: Driven by advances in artificial intelligence, de novo protein design can now generate diverse molecular functions from the ground up, achieving remarkable success in engineering binders against many macromolecular targets. Here, we provide a perspective on how de novo design can progress beyond bimolecular interactions toward the bottom-up construction of protein reaction networks. We highlight how programmable, modular, and controllable de novo components can drive complex, emergent biological behaviors. Overcoming current challenges-including designable protein dynamics, multi-step functionalities, and non-equilibrium systems-is essential for this transition. With continued foundational method improvements, the field is poised to pioneer precise protein perturbations for systems-level insight and to engineer emergent cellular behaviors like signal amplification, decision-making, and error correction de novo to fundamentally advance synthetic biology, biotechnology, and medicine.
abstract_zh: 在人工智能进步的推动下，从头蛋白质设计（de novo protein design）现已能够从零开始生成多种分子功能，在针对众多大分子靶点的结合剂工程化方面取得了显著成功。在此，我们提供了一个视角，探讨从头设计如何超越双分子相互作用，迈向蛋白质反应网络的自下而上构建。我们强调，可编程、模块化且可控的从头组件如何驱动复杂的涌现生物行为。克服当前挑战——包括可设计的蛋白质动力学、多步骤功能以及非平衡系统——对于这一转变至关重要。随着基础方法的持续改进，该领域有望开创精确蛋白质扰动以实现系统级洞察，并从头工程化涌现细胞行为，如信号放大、决策制定和错误校正，从而从根本上推进合成生物学、生物技术和医学。
